blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Occidental Mindoro – The Mangyan-Iraya Repungpungan sa Malatabako, an indigenous group in Abra de Ilog, Occidental Mindoro, has denounced what it calls “fabricated criminal charges” filed against its members by a real estate developer. They described the cases as retaliation for the legitimate defense of their ancestral domain. In a video statement posted by the group on Tuesday, the Samahan ng Katutubong Mangyan-Iraya sa Sitio Malatabako called for the dismissal of all charges, including trespassing, usurpation of real rights to property, and malicious mischief, which they said were filed in reprisal for their struggle to protect their ancestral land.
